dinners.name: Lemon-Dijon Chicken Thighs + Skillet Green Beans
dinners.note: Total carbs: Jake 11.5 g, Laine 8.7 g. Card carbs are net.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs (boneless, skinless) - Jake 370 g raw, Laine 240 g raw

steps: Season both batches of chicken with the listed total of dried thyme, salt and pepper. Sear in each person's measured olive oil until browned and 165°F. Keep portions separate and transfer the chicken to plates.
Blot the beans dry, then sauté in the same pans over medium-high heat until blistered and crisp-tender. Transfer to the plates.

dinners.name: Turkey & Ricotta Zucchini Rollatini
dinners.note: Uses 210 g from the same ricotta tub as Laine's dip. Reserve it when you open the tub. Total carbs: Jake 13 g, Laine 10 g. Card carbs are net.

ingredients.item: 93% lean ground turkey - Jake 255 g raw, Laine 150 g raw
Ricotta cheese (part-skim) - Jake 120 g, Laine 90 g
Zucchini - Jake 130 g, Laine 105 g
Tomato (slicing) - Jake 60 g, Laine 45 g
Grated Parmesan - Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp
Olive oil - Jake 0.8 tbsp, Laine 0.55 tbsp
Dry seasonings named in Steps - Jake 0.6 tsp, Laine 0.4 tsp

steps: Slice each zucchini portion lengthwise into thin ribbons. Brush with half of each person's olive oil and roast at 425°F for 7–10 minutes until flexible. Blot dry. Finely chop any end pieces for the turkey filling.

Brown each turkey portion in the remaining oil with its chopped zucchini ends and half its oregano, salt and pepper. Cook the turkey to 165°F. Separately simmer the diced tomato and remaining seasoning uncovered until a spatula dragged across the pan leaves a clean trail.

Whisk each ricotta portion with half its Parmesan, then fold in its turkey. Roll the mixture in the zucchini ribbons. Any filling that won't fit goes alongside the rolls in the same dish. Spoon the thick tomato reduction around the rolls, top with the remaining Parmesan and bake at 425°F for about 12 minutes until bubbling.

photo.alt: Turkey and ricotta zucchini rolls in fresh tomato sauce

dinners.name: Pan-Roasted Pork Loin + Thyme Jus & Sautéed Spinach
dinners.note: Pork is weighed raw. Saturday lunch weights appear on Saturday's card and are already in shopping. Total carbs: Jake 5.6 g, Laine 4.2 g. Card carbs are net.

ingredients.item: Pork loin - Jake 365 g raw, Laine 195 g raw
Baby spinach - Jake 120 g, Laine 90 g
Butter - Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Olive oil - Jake 0.75 tbsp, Laine 0.5 tbsp
Beef bouillon cube - Jake 0.15 cube, Laine 0.1 cube
Dijon mustard - Jake 1 tsp, Laine 0.75 tsp
Dry seasonings named in Steps - Jake 0.4 tsp, Laine 0.3 tsp

steps: Before cooking, cut and label the Saturday lunch portions separately: 260 g raw for Jake and 160 g raw for Laine. Add those to a separate oven tray with the Thursday jar portion (165 g raw, seasoned separately as directed on its card). Season tonight's portions with their measured mix of thyme, salt and pepper and sear in their olive oil.

Roast the dinner and lunch portions at 375°F until the centers reach 145°F, then rest for at least 3 minutes. Cool the Saturday portions promptly and freeze them individually Wednesday evening. Cool the Thursday jar portion and refrigerate it.

Wilt each spinach portion in half its butter. Let the moisture evaporate and transfer to plates. Deglaze the cooking pan with 60 mL of water per person and the listed total of ¼ beef bouillon cube, or the equivalent strength on your label. Boil uncovered to about 2 tablespoons total. Split about 60/40 between Jake and Laine, then whisk each portion's Dijon and remaining butter into its jus off the heat and spoon over the pork.

photo.alt: Pork loin slices with thyme jus and sautéed spinach

desserts.name: Dark Chocolate Mousse with Toasted Pecan Crunch
desserts.note: Two portions. The estimate assumes a zero-net-carb monk fruit blend. Use the sweetness conversion on your package. Total carbs: Jake 4.8 g, Laine 4.8 g. Card carbs are net.

ingredients.item: Heavy cream - Jake 50 g, Laine 50 g
Unsweetened cocoa powder - Jake 4 g, Laine 4 g
Pecans - Jake 7 g, Laine 7 g
Vanilla extract - Jake 0.125 tsp, Laine 0.125 tsp
Monk fruit sweetener (zero-net-carb blend) - Jake 0.75 tbsp sugar equivalent, Laine 0.75 tbsp sugar equivalent

steps: Toast the 14 g chopped pecans in a dry skillet over medium-low heat for 2 to 4 minutes, stirring until fragrant. Spread them on a plate to cool completely.

Sift 8 g unsweetened cocoa and powdered monk fruit sweetener into a chilled mixing bowl. Use the amount your blend says equals the sweetness of 1½ tbsp sugar for the full batch. Whisk in a splash of the 100 g cold heavy whipping cream to make a smooth paste.
Add the remaining cream, ¼ tsp vanilla and a small pinch of salt. Whip to medium peaks, until the tip bends over when you lift the whisk. Refrigerate for 45 minutes.
Just before serving, gently fold in most of the toasted pecans. Divide between two red 8 oz ramekins and scatter the remaining pecans over the tops. Add a few flakes of salt if you like.

photo.alt: Two red ramekins of chocolate mousse with toasted pecans

jakeLunch.note: Use 990 g (about 2.2 lb) of raw boneless, skinless thighs from what you have. Prep the three bowls Sunday for Monday–Wednesday. Keep the romaine and dressing separate until serving.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs (boneless, skinless) - 990 g raw total (330 g raw per serving)
Zucchini - 420 g total (140 g per serving)
Romaine lettuce - 210 g total (70 g per serving)
Large eggs - 6 eggs total (2 eggs per serving)
Olive oil - 6 tbsp total (2 tbsp per serving)

Grated Parmesan - 6 tbsp total (2 tbsp per serving)
Rice vinegar - 0.75 tbsp total (0.25 tbsp per serving)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the boneless, skinless thighs with 3 tbsp olive oil and a measured blend of cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and salt. Spread on a rimmed sheet pan and roast to 165°F in the thickest part, checking at 18 minutes. Rest and slice.
Cut the zucchini into thick half-moons and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil. Roast on a second pan until browned, about 15 to 20 minutes. Toss the hot zucchini with the measured butter and Parmesan.

Cover the eggs with cold water, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and keep covered for 12 minutes. Chill in ice water, peel and refrigerate separately. Divide the chicken and zucchini among 3 containers. Use shallow containers and refrigerate promptly.

Chop and thoroughly dry the romaine. Pack it separately from the warm food. Whisk 1 tbsp olive oil with the rice vinegar and pack the dressing separately. Reheat the chicken and zucchini to 165°F, then add the cold romaine, dressing and two chilled eggs.

Thinly slice the cabbage. Sauté in the remaining oil until the edges brown and the center is still crisp. Return the chicken. Off the heat, stir each person's Dijon through their portion and melt the grated cheddar on top.

prepPlan: Sunday, Nov 15. Cook the thighs you have for Jake’s three chicken bowls. Pack the dry romaine and dressing separately. Prep Laine's three chicken jars. Make three portions of whipped ricotta dip and reserve 210 g ricotta for Tuesday's rollatini. Pack the dip vegetables and pecans separately.
Check the freezer for two 1 lb packs of ground turkey and the salmon. Keep Friday's raw turkey and Saturday's sausage frozen until it's time to thaw them in the refrigerator.

Wednesday, Nov 18. Roast and label the Thursday jar portion and both Saturday lunch portions alongside the pork dinner. Assemble Laine's Thursday jar. Cool and freeze Saturday's pork promptly. Move Thursday's raw salmon and Friday's raw turkey to the refrigerator to thaw.

Friday, Nov 20. Flex Friday breakfast and lunch are shared at home. Move Saturday's cooked pork and raw sausage to the refrigerator in the morning. Chill the chocolate mousse before dinner. Fold in the toasted pecans just before serving.
Cool cooked batches promptly. Store refrigerated food at 40°F or colder, and reheat office leftovers to 165°F. Keep chilled lunch jars cold until serving.
